messages:
Olivia (Support): customer reported unexpectedly high token usage for a streaming call they canceled mid-generation. invoice inv_2026_03_12 quoted 3x expected tokens. attaching their SSE log snippet they sent.
Raj (Billing): can you paste the invoice id and the session id/time window?
Olivia (Support): inv_2026_03_12, session: session_8f7a2c, timeframe: 2026-03-12T14:22:10Z - 14:22:46Z
Marta (Eng): any internal request IDs from our side (x-request-id)? we need the full request traces to correlate metering events.
Olivia (Support): they included our header x-req: r-0a1b2c3d, and raw SSE frames:
Olivia (Support): ```
data: {"type":"chunk","seq":1,"tokens":12}

data: {"type":"chunk","seq":2,"tokens":10}

data: {"type":"chunk","seq":3,"tokens":8}

data: {"type":"final","seq":3,"tokens":0}

# then client sent cancel:
data: {"type":"client_cancel","reason":"user_abort"}
```
Theo (Monitoring Bot): linked trace r-0a1b2c3d -> span ids 7f4e.. on proxy, got forwarded to runtime node gpu-6.
Marta (Eng): ok looking at our token-meter pipeline: streaming chunks increment a transient counter on receipt, finalization writes consolidated usage. suspect race between client_cancel and final chunk ack.
Raj (Billing): customer says dashboard showed X tokens ~30 and invoice charged ~92. where are the extra tokens coming from?
Marta (Eng): preliminary: we saw three chunk events (12+10+8=30) plus a separate finalization event that re-emitted total tokens for the request due to a fallback double-ack bug -> double-count. initial hypothesis: when final chunk and final flag arrive near-simultaneously, the runtime emitted both per-chunk increments and a final aggregate event; metering ingestor accepted both.
Olivia (Support): can we repro locally? customer provided a short repro: open SSE, stream prompt, mid-chunk client abort after final flagged. they said they used our JS SSE client and called evtSource.close() on cancel.
Marta (Eng): please paste the exact SSE sequence they'd used (headers + small payload) or a minimal repro script.
Olivia (Support): they sent this snippet:```
const es = new EventSource(url, {headers:{Authorization: 'Bearer ...'}});
es.onmessage = e => { /* append tokens */ if (shouldCancel) { es.close(); fetch('/cancel', {method:'POST'}) }}
```
Marta (Eng): thanks. trying to repro now with timeouts. if we see double accounting i'll add logging to the meter pipeline.
Theo (Monitoring Bot): alert: metering-queue observed duplicate "finalize" events for request r-0a1b2c3d at 2026-03-12T14:22:46.123Z and 2026-03-12T14:22:46.129Z (6ms apart).
Marta (Eng): that's the critical bit — two finalize events within a few ms. likely one emitted by runtime and one by a retry path in the proxy on close.
Raj (Billing): any way to identify which event caused the invoice to include the duplicate? we need to produce a credit if it's our bug.
Marta (Eng): we'll trace metering event ids: if the finalization event included aggregate_total=92 and per_chunk events also present, invoice system summed both. I'm going to open a reconciler ticket to dedupe identical finalize events by request id + finalized flag.
recon-bot: Created ticket BILL-4823: "dedupe finalize events for streaming by request id". Priority P1.
Olivia (Support): I told customer we're investigating and asked for the raw SSE payload and their client code. they responded appreciative. :thumbsup:
Raj (Billing): please capture a list of impacted invoices/sessions so we can compute provisional credits.
Marta (Eng): action items: 1) add a short-term dedupe in the metering consumer (idempotency by request_id + finalize marker) 2) add extra logging on runtime->proxy finalize emission 3) produce a reproduction harness that cancels mid-final-chunk to validate fix. i'll push a branch and ping here.
Olivia (Support): ETA to customer? they want to know if we'll credit them.
Raj (Billing): if we can confirm double-counted events for session_8f7a2c -> issue credit for the delta and flag invoices touched. i'll draft a template credit note.
Marta (Eng): pushed quick dedupe patch to staging and ran the repro -> duplication prevented, meter shows 30 tokens only. will run load test.
Theo (Monitoring Bot): deploy-log: staging metering-consumer v1.14.2 deployed.
Marta (Eng): candidate rollback mitigation: if production shows duplicates for >0.1% traffic, enable dedupe toggle and run reconciliation job to correct invoices.
recon-bot: Reconciliation job started for inv_2026_03_12 session_8f7a2c. Job id REC-9192.
Olivia (Support): telling customer we expect a fix to prevent reoccurrence and we'll credit the delta for their invoice.
Raj (Billing): please attach REC-9192 output when done and I'll finalize credit.
Marta (Eng): will follow up in 24h with post-mortem of root cause (proxy retry path + finalize race).
Olivia (Support): thanks team. closing loop with customer once REC-9192 confirms delta. :white_check_mark:
